title: Lankaran State University students protest winter exam-score issues
notes: Scholars at Risk names four detained student activists; one participant account says three were together at detention. The separate figure of about 100 refers to students filing complaints, not protest attendance. Neither source establishes a gathering of at least 50; the total attendance remains unknown. The OC Media URL is not reopened because the January card records an observed 403.

title: Feminist activists protest killings of women in Baku
notes: The later Dutch COI report gives six women-rights activists; the contemporary VOA account does not quantify attendance. OC Media describes an interviewee who had spoken to VOA, so the two are not independent confirmation. Venue differs: VOA/OC Media say Government House, while COI says parliament/SCFWCA. The femicide grievance does not establish protest-time state killings.

title: Female relatives of detained activists protest outside the US Embassy
notes: The opened COI report estimates about ten women and says police stopped the protest after ten minutes. The Toplum result is search-only and not counted as independent confirmation. Keep separate from the 9 February family action; no continuous episode or shared organizer is established.

title: Search-only lead about a woman protesting outside AzTV
notes: Search-result titles describe a woman protesting or attempting self-immolation outside AzTV, with employer-response articles. No article body, crowd size or demand recipient was obtained. A prior January continuation lists 8 February, but the available source cards show publication dates 8/9 February only; they do not verify incident onset.
